edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Sona's Crescendo (R) is down 140s at rank 1, 100s at rank 3 — spread while it is up so one stun can't chain your duo. - Keep R Unbreakable Will banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
